result.summary: The intersection features wide sidewalks and decorative paving, but lacks traditional painted crosswalks and lane markings, creating a large, ambiguous space for both drivers and pedestrians. While traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the significant crossing distance increases pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of defined crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of high-visibility painted markings makes the intended pedestrian path less clear to drivers.

hazards.name: Wide, open intersection geometry
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings and wide pavement area can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable maneuvers.

hazards.name: Long crossing exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of roadway without a mid-crossing refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: The entire width of the street crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style painted markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the crossing to reduce exposure and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with a textured, colored crosswalk and signalized pedestrian crossings. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of physical refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes and a wide intersection area without a mid-point refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Daylighting
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection can obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street where cars are parked near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multi-lane traffic and textured crosswalks. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of physical refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
